title.vi: Quy chế COVID-19 (Biện pháp Tạm thời) (Giảm nhẹ theo Phần 8B) 2020
title.th: ข้อบังคับโควิด-19 (มาตรการชั่วคราว) (การผ่อนปรนตามภาค 8B) 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the COVID‑19 (Temporary Measures) (Part 8B Relief) Regulations 2020 and come into operation on 30 November 2020.

heading.en: Prescribed period for section 39D of Act

text.en: 2. For the purpose of section 39D(1)(c) of the Act, the prescribed period for the description of contracts to which the construction contract belongs is the period prescribed under section 3(1) of the Act (as may be extended or shortened under section 3(2)(b) of the Act) for that description of contracts.
